anti_overlap: fd-ux-information-hierarchy handles user-facing design; this agent focuses on technical component structure
decision_lens: Prioritizes findings where the proposed component changes could cause unnecessary client-side JavaScript, data-fetching redundancy, or poor separation of concerns.
focus: React/Next.js component design, server-client boundary, and reuse patterns for the new homepage
name: fd-frontend-component-architecture
persona: A senior frontend architect experienced with Next.js App Router who focuses on the server-client boundary and component composition patterns.
review_areas: Evaluate whether the Best For tiles can be a pure server component or if they need client interactivity, and the implications for bundle size
Check if extracting scoring logic from the wizard into a shared utility creates coupling issues between the homepage and /recommend page
Assess whether removing HomeScatterPlot and home-scatter-presets.ts leaves orphaned imports or affects other pages
Review the data-fetching pattern: both homepage and /recommend fetch the same data — should this be a shared cached function?

severity_examples.condition: Hero requires 'use client' when server-rendered links would suffice
severity_examples.scenario: Making the hero use-case selector a client component adds the entire wizard + scoring logic to the homepage JS bundle

success_hints: Homepage hero is a server component (no 'use client')
Best For tiles are server-rendered with ISR, zero client JS
Scoring logic shared without coupling pages
task_context: AgMoDB homepage redesign brainstorm: moving from a data-showcase homepage (scatter plot + recently-updated cards) to a task-oriented homepage with a single-step recommend wizard hero (use case selector) and pre-computed 'Best For' category tiles showing top 3 models per category. The brainstorm covers UX restructuring, component architecture, server-side scoring reuse, and navigation changes.
